items.title: Shell Command
items.subtitle: Runs a command, then returns to the list

info.summary: The simplest action type. Runs the command and brings you back to Tuisual afterwards.

items.title: Shell Command (Exit)
items.subtitle: Runs a command, then closes Tuisual

info.summary: Same as shell_command, but Tuisual exits right after launching it. Good for opening apps or long-running programs.

items.title: Shell Command With Flag
items.subtitle: Prompts for input, then runs command+flag

info.summary: Switches straight to a text prompt. Whatever you type is appended after flag_prefix and the result is run as one command.

items.title: Provider Hint
items.subtitle: Jumps to another provider's item list

info.summary: Instead of running a command, this loads another provider by name. Useful for building a menu of menus.

items.title: Static Flags Menu
items.subtitle: Space/Enter to pick a preset flag combo

info.summary: require_sub_item forces you to pick one of the fixed options below; each sub_item just appends its own preset flags to the base command.

items.title: Single Input Prompt
items.subtitle: One-step compose: type a value, then run

info.summary: A single sub_item with an input field. Selecting it opens a text prompt; the typed text is appended after flag_prefix and the command runs.

sub_items.title: Target (Input)
sub_items.subtitle: Type a value; --target= is added automatically

items.title: Multi-Step Compose Chain
items.subtitle: Chain several inputs together before running

info.summary: Each step requires the next until the final one, which runs the fully composed command. Great for building a command out of several pieces of user input in sequence.

sub_items.title: Step 1: Name (Input)
sub_items.subtitle: Type a name, then continue to step 2

sub_items.title: Step 2: Category (Choose)
sub_items.subtitle: Pick a category, then continue to step 3

sub_items.title: Step 3: Note (Input, Final)
sub_items.subtitle: Type a closing note; runs the composed command
